protocol.sample_rule: Fixed ordered pool of 20 NEW inputs; aim for 15 additional complete valid pairs. Invalid A fails its own turn, creates no reusable candidate and no B call; retain the attempt and proceed to the next independent predeclared sample. Never repeat, repair, replace or tune a sample. Invalid B is evaluated from the saved S and retained in authority/reliability denominators.
protocol.state_rule: Persist full authoritative pre-second-Appraisal state S before dispatching B. Independently restore CONTROL(B) and SHADOW(A), compare exact complete states and real V2 cognition projections. No normalization except object-key order. Baseline versus restored CONTROL may differ only in the existing restore-local reservation counter and derived receipts, separately recorded.
protocol.latency_rule: Monotonic product native transport timing; capture observer copy overhead separately and subtract observed synchronous instrumentation only. Include real transport/body parsing, exclude state serialization, disk writes, metadata checks and shadow execution. Retain raw client timing, adjusted timing and Ollama timing/token fields. No optional end-to-end generation benchmark in this slice.
protocol.identity_rule: Retain V0 complete normalized actual wire request plus observed implementation/model/config identity and fingerprint, and its separate subject/turn/process/restart/provider-instance scope. Compare full identity as well as hash and prove distinct event identities for every pair.
protocol.stopping_rule: Stop on 15 complete valid pairs, 40 attempted Appraisal inferences, exhaustion of the fixed pool, an identity/authority defect, or observed material canonical/Affect/downstream/admission/failure-boundary divergence AFTER real isolated authority evaluation. A lone malformed A is reliability evidence, not a whole-experiment stop. Transport infrastructure failure stops truthfully; no retries or model switching.
protocol.decision_rule: Approve a bounded production slice if request identity, event authority/failure firewalls, scope isolation, at least 12 additional completed pairs covering the hard-case pool, no observed material paired consequence divergence, useful measured local latency and bounded implementation complexity support it. Do not demand mathematical determinism. Stop after a material paired difference and make a conservative NO engineering decision based on the demonstrated non-equivalence; disclose small frequency denominators rather than call a single difference frequent. Synthetic provider-B failures demonstrate the expected difference between removing an inference failure and bypassing an event authority gate; they alone do not count as observed model divergence. Unknown is reserved for a concrete infrastructure/identity-attribution blocker, never merely wanting more samples.
